title: Strongpoint v0.0.13
author: StandardStrange2038
selftext:
Did a whole bunch of gunsmithing here for this update. Of course now that Im digging into animation for v0.0.14 I'm finding that Im basically undoing all of the gun placements to accommodate TPF...   
  
Really wish Claude had a bit more foresight so I didn't have to tune all these weapons again but oh well. Part of the learning curve. Note to all other devs out there, do your animations before tuning weapon/object placement in characters hands. Smooths a lot of the problems Im now fixing before they become problems.  
  
Would love feedback, games come a long way since I last shared it. close to 5 or 6 versions I think. Let me know what you think!
